findings.title: Preparation changes the kind of relationship milestone
findings.observed: In HeartsUI Step, count red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple feeding flags equal to 2. Count >=3 assigns new_heart_type 2; zero assigns 1; otherwise 0. Increment hearts_level and store that type in heart1_type, heart2_type, or heart3_type for levels >=3. These are typed milestones, not just one scalar affection bar.

findings.qualification: Numeric feeding/heart meanings are recovered. No claim that these are mutually consensual romance states or that all natural routes reach the handler.

findings.title: Final recollections use distinct conduct counters
findings.observed: Three VN scripts add their argument to points_good, points_sleaze and points_wicked. Another comparison reads point_wicked, singular, which differs from the incremented points_wicked name.

ranked_proposals.title: A gift with a preparation history
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: Use native gathering/crafting and one optional Village conversation: freshly prepared, improvised or postponed. Store the cause with the relationship memory; original character and text.
ranked_proposals.scope: Small: one event and three outcomes.

ranked_proposals.title: Relationships remember what each milestone cost
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: Record a bounded typed memory for each shared milestone. A later invitation reads one earlier cause, including collateral damage, rather than only total trust.
ranked_proposals.scope: Small first slice; broader romance remains a proposal.

ranked_proposals.title: A closing conversation recalls the way you behaved
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: Choose finale lines from concrete kept/broken promises, help and boundary violations. Reuse relationship axes/ties and cause IDs rather than a universal morality score.
ranked_proposals.scope: Small: one person, two remembered deeds.

ranked_proposals.title: Household preparation matures on the existing clock
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: One crafted meal or repaired keepsake moves from waiting to ready after a native time boundary, with clear expiry or preservation rules.
ranked_proposals.scope: Medium: declare offline policy and no wall-clock surprise loss.

ranked_proposals.title: A relationship episode can end without ending the life
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: Close one optional friendship/romance episode with a remembered status and practical aftermath; native unconsciousness, home opening and ongoing professions continue.
ranked_proposals.scope: Medium: new optional content state, old-save default.

ranked_proposals.title: Remembered accomplishments have a separate retention policy
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: Keep a compact biography of completed episodes and clear discovery labels. Separate personal-memory retention from power and cross-world travel.
ranked_proposals.scope: Medium: migration and explicit restart policy required.

ranked_proposals.title: Care for bystanders changes the reunion
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: An optional shared event records whether a dependent, pet or neighbor was protected; the later NPC response reads that deed with a stated cause.
ranked_proposals.scope: Medium: bounded named actors, no population simulator.

ranked_proposals.title: Explain a blocked intimate scene in the center menu
ranked_proposals.original_yair_proposal: List missing preparation, time/place and the other person's current willingness as prose beside the native action. Give postponement its own consequence.
ranked_proposals.scope: Small: center action and inline reasons, no new window.
